what: backtest_trend.py fills trail_stop/take_profit exits AT the level even when the exit bar opened through it (no gap-fill rule). MEASURED 2026-10-30 on corpus v1 (2,627 trades, six money legs): on 255 trail_stop + 1 take_profit exits (9.7% of trades, mostly trend_donchian_eth_4h and _eth_prop) the engine's gap-fill at the open is lower than the harness exit_r by a mean 0.30 R, i.e. ~0.029 R/trade of harness exit optimism pooled (the stop-first sign: 'stop' and 'stale_stop' exits are unaffected). Every TM-BENCH delta is vs the replayed B0 so it cancels there, but any Stage-0 net R of those legs carries it. Decide: add the gap rule to the harness (min(level, open) for a long stop) and re-run the affected legs' Stage-0 evidence, or record it as a stated bias on those records.
